newsitem.title: UK: MSAS opens new logistics centre in Kuala Lumpur.
newsitem.headline: MSAS opens new logistics centre in Kuala Lumpur.

text.p: MSAS Malaysia, part of international freight forwarders MSAS Cargo International, said it has opened a new logistics centre in Subang Jaya, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
The 82,400 sq ft centre includes 20,OOO sq ft of office space and is located just 25 minutes from Kuala Lumpur airport and 45 minutes from Port Klang (Malaysia's major seaport).

Some 62,000 sq ft of the centre is dedicated to Minolta on a three plus two-year contract. MSAS packs and distributes finished cameras world-wide as well as bringing in materials and parts from Minolta's Asian suppliers and contractors. Minolta hopes office automation and all Minolta products will be handled at the centre.

"This is further evidence of MSAS responding to customers' needs, by providing them the full-range of supply chain services wherever our customer needs them," said MSAS's country manager for Malaysia Chan Kim Sooi. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
